translations.web: “I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
translations.bsb: I have forsaken My house; I have abandoned My inheritance. I have given the beloved of My soul into the hands of her enemies.
translations.kjv: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
